summary: This note covers the 2018 film Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again, including its London premiere, its July 20, 2018 release in the UK and US, and its reception. Critics gave it generally positive reviews praising the performances and musical numbers. The note's box office figures conflict: two paragraphs give a worldwide gross of over $350 million and over $345 million, while a later figure as of October 11, 2018 gives a total of $392.8 million against a $75 million budget.
one_line: Premiere, release, reception, and box office and budget figures for the 2018 musical sequel Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again.
key_facts: Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again premiered at the Hammersmith Apollo in London on July 16, 2018.
Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again was released in the United Kingdom and the United States on July 20, 2018, ten years to the week of its predecessor's release.
The film was released in both standard and IMAX formats.
One paragraph states the film has grossed over $350 million worldwide, while a repeated paragraph states over $345 million, so the note contains conflicting worldwide gross figures.
The film received generally positive reviews, with critics praising the performances and musical numbers.

A statement says the film is scheduled for release in the United States and the United Kingdom on July 20, 2018, ten years to the month of the original film's release, which conflicts with the 'ten years to the week' wording and with the film already being released.
As of October 11, 2018, Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again had grossed $120.6 million in the United States and Canada.
As of October 11, 2018, Mamma Mia! Here We Go Again had grossed $272.2 million in other territories.
As of October 11, 2018, the film's total worldwide gross was $392.8 million.
The film had a production budget of $75 million.
